title: feat: command target parsing for bash command segments
prompt: Parse command targets to find the effective working directory and commit status for bash command segments. Touch guard/agent/bash.py and add unit tests in tests/test_command_target.py.
diff:
diff --git a/guard/agent/bash.py b/guard/agent/bash.py
index 0f91d00..20fdf23 100644
--- a/guard/agent/bash.py
+++ b/guard/agent/bash.py
@@ -9,11 +9,13 @@ tree is compared before and after (git status + content hashes) to see what it r
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import hashlib
+import ntpath
 import os
+import posixpath
 import re
 import shlex
 from pathlib import Path
-from typing import Dict, List, Optional
+from typing import Dict, List, NamedTuple, Optional, Tuple
 
 from guard.core.ocr_engine import GitDiffInspector
 
@@ -299,3 +301,297 @@ def worktree_fingerprint(repo: Path) -> Dict[str, str]:
 
 def changed_between(before: Dict[str, str], after: Dict[str, str]) -> List[str]:
     return sorted(p for p in set(before) | set(after) if before.get(p) != after.get(p))
+
+
+class CommandTarget(NamedTuple):
+    directory: Optional[str]
+    is_git_commit: bool
+    segment: str
+
+
+CONTROL_KEYWORDS = {
+    "if", "then", "else", "elif", "fi", "for", "while", "until", "do", "done", "case", "esac", "select"
+}
+
+
+def _unquote(p: str) -> str:
+    p = p.strip()
+    return p[1:-1].strip() if (p.startswith(('"', "'")) and len(p) >= 2 and p[-1] == p[0]) else p
+
+
+def _norm_path(raw: Optional[str], base: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if not raw:
+        return None
+    p = _unquote(raw)
+    if not p or p in ("-", "~") or p.startswith("~") or any(c in p for c in "$`%*?"):
+        return None
+    drive = ntpath.splitdrive(p)[0]
+    if drive or p.startswith(("\\\\", "//", "/")):
+        if p.startswith("/") and not drive:
+            return posixpath.normpath(p)
+        res = ntpath.normpath(p)
+        d = ntpath.splitdrive(res)[0]
+        return (d.upper() + res[len(d):]) if d else res
+    if base is None:
+        return None
+    is_win = bool(ntpath.splitdrive(base)[0] or "\\" in base or "\\" in p)
+    if not is_win and base.startswith("/"):
+        return posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(base, p))
+    res = ntpath.normpath(ntpath.join(base, p))
+    d = ntpath.splitdrive(res)[0]
+    return (d.upper() + res[len(d):]) if d else res
+
+
+def _split_command_segments(command: str) -> Optional[List[Tuple[str, str]]]:
+    clean = strip_heredocs(command.replace("\\\n", ""))
+    segments: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
+    curr: List[str] = []
+    quote = ""
+    i, n = 0, len(clean)
+    while i < n:
+        ch = clean[i]
+        if quote:
+            curr.append(ch)
+            if ch == "\\" and quote == '"' and i + 1 < n:
+                i += 1
+                curr.append(clean[i])
+            elif ch == quote:
+                quote = ""
+        elif ch in "'\"":
+            quote = ch
+            curr.append(ch)
+        elif ch == "#" and (i == 0 or clean[i - 1] in " \t;&|()"):
+            nl = clean.find("\n", i)
+            if nl == -1:
+                break
+            i = nl
+            continue
+        elif clean[i : i + 2] in ("&&", "||"):
+            seg = "".join(curr).strip()
+            if seg:
+                segments.append((seg, clean[i : i + 2]))
+            curr = []
+            i += 2
+            continue
+        elif ch in (";", "|", "&", "\n"):
+            seg = "".join(curr).strip()
+            if seg:
+                segments.append((seg, ch))
+            curr = []
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        else:
+            curr.append(ch)
+        i += 1
+    if quote:
+        return None
+    seg = "".join(curr).strip()
+    if seg:
+        segments.append((seg, ""))
+    return segments
+
+
+def _segment_words(segment_str: str) -> List[str]:
+    lexer = shlex.shlex(segment_str, posix=False, punctuation_chars=";&|<>")
+    lexer.whitespace_split = True
+    lexer.commenters = ""
+    try:
+        return [tok for tok in lexer if tok not in (";", "&&", "||", "|", "&")]
+    except ValueError:
+        return []
+
+
+def _cd_target(words: List[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    args = words[1:]
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(args):
+        a = args[i]
+        low = a.lower()
+        if low in ("/d", "-p", "-l", "--"):
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        for pfx in ("-path:", "-literalpath:", "-path=", "-literalpath="):
+            if low.startswith(pfx):
+                return _unquote(a[len(pfx) :])
+        if low in ("-path", "-literalpath"):
+            return _unquote(args[i + 1]) if i + 1 < len(args) else None
+        if low.startswith("-"):
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        return _unquote(a)
+    return None
+
+
+def _git_dir_and_c_paths(raw_tokens: List[str], git_words: List[str]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
+    for tok in raw_tokens:
+        if not ASSIGNMENT.match(tok):
+            break
+        if tok.split("=", 1)[0].upper() in ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE"):
+            return True, []
+    paths: List[str] = []
+    i = 1
+    while i < len(git_words):
+        w = git_words[i]
+        low = w.lower()
+        if low in ("--git-dir", "--work-tree") or low.startswith(("--git-dir=", "--work-tree=")):
+            return True, []
+        if w == "-C":
+            if i + 1 < len(git_words):
+                paths.append(git_words[i + 1])
+                i += 2
+                continue
+            return True, []
+        elif w.startswith("-C") and len(w) > 2:
+            paths.append(w[2:])
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        elif w in ("-c", "--namespace"):
+            i += 2
+            continue
+        elif w.startswith("-"):
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        else:
+            break
+    return False, paths
+
+
+def _extract_nested_shell(prog: str, words: List[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    for i, w in enumerate(words[:-1]):
+        low = w.lower()
+        if prog in ("powershell", "pwsh"):
+            if low in ("-c", "-command", "/c", "/command"):
+                rest = words[i + 1 :]
+                return " ".join(rest) if rest else None
+            for pfx in ("-c:", "-command:", "/c:", "/command:"):
+                if low.startswith(pfx):
+                    rest = [w.split(":", 1)[1]] + words[i + 1 :]
+                    return " ".join(rest) if rest else None
+        elif prog == "cmd":
+            if low in ("/c", "/k", "-c"):
+                rest = words[i + 1 :]
+                return " ".join(rest) if rest else None
+        else:
+            if low == "-c" or (
+                low.startswith("-")
+                and not low.startswith("--")
+                and low.endswith("c")
+                and all(c in "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" for c in low[1:])
+            ):
+                rest = words[i + 1 :]
+                return " ".join(rest) if rest else None
+    return None
+
+
+def command_targets(
+    command: str, cwd: Optional[str] = None, _depth: int = 0, shell: Optional[str] = None
+) -> list[CommandTarget]:
+    norm_cwd = _norm_path(".", cwd or os.path.abspath(".")) if cwd is not None else None
+    if _depth > 3:
+        return [CommandTarget(directory=None, is_git_commit=is_git_commit(command), segment=command)]
+
+    raw_segments = _split_command_segments(command)
+    if raw_segments is None:
+        return [CommandTarget(directory=None, is_git_commit=is_git_commit(command), segment=command)]
+
+    targets: list[CommandTarget] = []
+    current_dir: Optional[str] = norm_cwd
+    dir_stack: List[Optional[str]] = []
+    prev_sep = ""
+
+    for idx, (seg_str, sep) in enumerate(raw_segments):
+        raw_words = _segment_words(seg_str)
+        words = _words(raw_words)
+        unwrapped = _unwrap(words)
+        prog = _program(unwrapped) if unwrapped else ""
+
+        next_prog = ""
+        if idx + 1 < len(raw_segments):
+            next_unwrapped = _unwrap(_words(_segment_words(raw_segments[idx + 1][0])))
+            next_prog = _program(next_unwrapped) if next_unwrapped else ""
+
+        # Check subshell / grouping or control keywords at command position
+        seg_s = seg_str.lstrip()
+        is_grouped = seg_s.startswith(("(", "{")) or seg_str.rstrip().endswith((")", "}"))
+        is_control = prog in CONTROL_KEYWORDS
+        if is_grouped or is_control:
+            seg_clean = re.sub(r"[(){}]", " ", seg_str).strip()
+            words_clean = seg_clean.split()
+            s_no_ctl = (
+                " ".join(words_clean[1:])
+                if words_clean and words_clean[0].lower() in CONTROL_KEYWORDS
+                else seg_clean
+            )
+            is_commit = (
+                is_git_commit(seg_str)
+                or _looks_like_commit(seg_str)
+                or (bool(seg_clean) and is_git_commit(seg_clean))
+                or (bool(s_no_ctl) and is_git_commit(s_no_ctl))
+            )
+            targets.append(CommandTarget(directory=None, is_git_commit=is_commit, segment=seg_str))
+            current_dir = None
+            prev_sep = sep
+            continue
+
+        if prog in SHELLS:
+            inner_cmd = _extract_nested_shell(prog, unwrapped)
+            inner_targets: list[CommandTarget] = []
+            if inner_cmd:
+                ic = _unquote(inner_cmd)
+                inner_targets = command_targets(ic, current_dir, _depth + 1, shell=prog)
+            if any(t.is_git_commit for t in inner_targets):
+                targets.extend(inner_targets)
+                prev_sep = sep
+                continue
+            if is_git_commit(seg_str) or _looks_like_commit(seg_str) or (inner_cmd and is_git_commit(inner_cmd)):
+                targets.append(CommandTarget(directory=None, is_git_commit=True, segment=seg_str))
+                prev_sep = sep
+                continue
+            if inner_targets:
+                targets.extend(inner_targets)
+                prev_sep = sep
+                continue
+
+        effective_dir = current_dir
+        if prog == "git":
+            has_override, c_paths = _git_dir_and_c_paths(raw_words, unwrapped)
+            if has_override:
+                effective_dir = None
+            elif c_paths:
+                res = current_dir
+                for cp in c_paths:
+                    res = _norm_path(cp, res or norm_cwd)
+                    if res is None:
+                        break
+                effective_dir = res
+
+        repo_arg = Path(effective_dir) if effective_dir and Path(effective_dir).is_dir() else None
+        is_commit = is_git_commit(seg_str, repo_arg)
+        targets.append(CommandTarget(directory=effective_dir, is_git_commit=is_commit, segment=seg_str))
+
+        if prog in ("pop-location", "popd"):
+            current_dir = dir_stack.pop() if dir_stack else None
+        elif prog in ("push-location", "pushd", "cd", "chdir", "set-location", "sl"):
+            if prog in ("push-location", "pushd"):
+                dir_stack.append(current_dir)
+            tpath = _cd_target(unwrapped)
+            new_dir = _norm_path(
+                tpath, norm_cwd if (tpath and _norm_path(tpath, None) is not None) else current_dir
+            )
+
+            if prev_sep == "||":
+                current_dir = None
+            elif sep == "||":
+                current_dir = new_dir if next_prog in ("exit", "return", "throw", "die") else None
+            elif sep in (";", "&&", "\n"):
+                current_dir = new_dir
+            elif sep == "&":
+                current_dir = new_dir if shell == "cmd" else None
+
+        prev_sep = sep
+
+    return targets
+
+
+def commit_directories(command: str, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Optional[str]]:
+    return [t.directory for t in command_targets(command, cwd) if t.is_git_commit]

defects.summary: `strict`-style command parser returned a concrete but wrong directory for about ten shapes and dropped commits behind git aliases
